title: Drum
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- drum shell -->
  <rect x='25' y='35' width='50' height='40' rx='6' fill='#c0392b'/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <rect x='25' y='35' width='50' height='8' rx='4' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- top head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='25' ry='10' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='25' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#d9c49a' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rim hoop top -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='35' rx='25' ry='10' fill='none' stroke='#e8b84b' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- bottom head hint -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='25' ry='9' fill='#a93226'/>
  <!-- rim hoop bottom -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='75' rx='25' ry='9' fill='none' stroke='#e8b84b' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- tension lugs -->
  <rect x='27' y='38' width='6' height='34' rx='3' fill='#e8b84b'/>
  <rect x='67' y='38' width='6' height='34' rx='3' fill='#e8b84b'/>
  <!-- side highlight -->
  <rect x='44' y='44' width='5' height='26' rx='2' fill='#e74c3c'/>
  <!-- drumsticks -->
  <line x1='35' y1='20' x2='58' y2='30' stroke='#d9a066' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='65' y1='20' x2='44' y2='30' stroke='#d9a066' stroke-width='4' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stick tips -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='30' r='3' fill='#f5e6c8'/>
</svg>
